sentences.text: Evasion lets a unit evade an incoming attack, triggering upon projectile impact for ranged attackers and at the attack point for melee ones.
When an attack is evaded, effects relying on attacks hitting — most attack modifiers and on-hit effects — do not trigger unless explicitly specified.
All evasion sources use pseudo-random distribution.
Melee attacks miss 100% of the time if the target is farther than 350 range beyond the melee unit's attack range (buffer = attack range + both bound radii + 350).
Ranged units without flying movement miss 25% of attacks when at a lower terrain level than the target, checked at projectile impact regardless of level difference size.
Blind is a debuff on the attacker; blind sources stack additively and cap at 100% for effective evasion calculations.
Multiple evasion sources stack diminishingly with each other, while blind stacks multiplicatively with evasion.
Effective Evade Chance = (1 − (1 − Total Evasion) × (1 − Total Blind)) × (1 − Melee Buffer Range Miss), and Final Hit Chance = 1 − Effective Evade Chance × (1 − Total Accuracy).
Incoming attacks hit a Butterfly wielder 65% of the time, since the item grants 35% evasion.
Evasion items: Butterfly 35% (5450), Heaven's Halberd 25% (3400), Radiance 25% (4700), Talisman of Evasion 15% (1300).
True Strike prevents a unit's attacks from missing, negating both evasion and blind against targets including ward-type and allied units but not buildings, and applies no accuracy debuff.
Cleave and splash cannot miss secondary targets, but a missed attack produces no cleave or splash damage at all.
